messageID.description: unique id of the message to correlate with the request

preencodedPayloadContentType.description: content type of the pre-encoded payload

timestamp.description: time at which the message was created, in microseconds since the epoch

version.description: version of the message contract, for example v1. Not a semantic version. The client refuses the handshake if it does not match its own version

authorization.description: authorization credentials of the sender, reserved, not processed yet
